verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing claims integrations with external CI services such as Drone, Woodpecker, and Jenkins, and community users report running Gitea with Drone for years. That implies external CI results flow back into Gitea, but no evidence says these builds appear as status checks on commits or pull requests. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a commit status API or status-check display on commits/PRs, evidence of PR merge gating on external statuses, hands-on corroboration of external CI statuses rendering in the UI.
